versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the seo-ahrefs skill, providing integration with the Ahrefs API via the tested @ahrefs/mcp@0.0.11 server.
- Supports live retrieval of referring domains, backlinks, organic keywords, and content explorer data.
- Pairs with the seo-backlinks skill for multi-source confidence weighting and toxic link assessment.
- Includes clear prerequisites, usage commands, cost guardrails, and routing for specific Ahrefs metrics.
- Designed to work with Node 18+ and requires prior installation of the MCP server and an Ahrefs API token.
